question: Mene ne sunan bikin da ake yi wajen saukar suna ga jariri?
explanation: Bikin suna shine babban shagalin da ake gabatarwa domin sanya wa jariri suna a rana ta bakwai.

question: A al'adance, a wane kwana bayan haihuwa ake yanka rago a wajen suna?
explanation: A al'adance ana yin bikin suna ne a rana ta bakwai bayan haihuwar jariri.

question: Wane suna ne ake ba wa yaro idan aka haife shi bayan tagwaye?
explanation: A wasu al'adun Hausawa, ana kiran yaron da ya biyo bayan tagwaye da suna Kado ko Mairama.

question: Wane suna ake yi wa yaron da aka haifa a lokacin wani babban abu ko bala'i?
explanation: Ana kiran irin wadannan sunaye da sunayen yanayi saboda suna nuna lokacin da aka haifi yaron.

question: Menene ma'anar sunan 'Auta' a tsarin haihuwar Hausawa?
explanation: Auta shine sunan da ake bai wa yaro na karshe a cikin gida.

question: Wane suna ne ake bai wa dan farko idan yana da wuya a samu haihuwa?
explanation: Sunaye kamar Maikudi ko Jatau suna iya zama sunayen da ake sakawa domin nuna godiya ko daraja.

question: Wane suna ne aka fi bai wa yaron da aka haifa bayan an dade ana jiran haihuwa?
explanation: Kalmar Jibir ko irin wadannan sunaye na nuna farin ciki da jiran dadewa.

question: Wane suna ake sawa idan an haifi yaro ranar Juma'a?
explanation: Jummai shine sunan da aka saba bai wa 'yar da aka haifa a ranar Juma'a.

question: Me ake nufi da sunan 'Balarabe' a tsarin sanya suna?
explanation: Balarabe yana daga cikin sunayen da ake amfani da su wajen nuna dangantaka ko asali.

question: Wane mataki ne ke biyo bayan saukar suna ga jariri a al'ada?
explanation: Aikin aske gashin kan jariri na daya daga cikin muhimman abubuwan da ake yi yayin bikin suna.

question: Wane ne ke zuwa da 'ta mako' a al'adun Hausawa?
explanation: Aminin ango ko 'danike shi ne ke kawo kyautar ta mako ga amarya.
subtopic: Al'adun Neman Aure da Bikin Aure

question: Menene sunan kudin farko da ake bayarwa lokacin neman aure?
explanation: Ana fara bayar da kudin gaisuwa ne kafin a tsaida maganar aure.
subtopic: Al'adun Neman Aure da Bikin Aure

question: Wane mataki ne ke biyo bayan amincewar neman aure?
explanation: Bayan an amince, ana gudanar da binciken asalin dangin juna kafin a dora.
subtopic: Al'adun Neman Aure da Bikin Aure

question: Mene ne ma'anar 'Kudin Goro' a harkar aure?

options.B: Amsar da iyaye suka ba da

explanation: Ana kiran amsar da iyayen yarinya suka bayar bayan an je neman aure da kudin goro.
subtopic: Al'adun Neman Aure da Bikin Aure

question: Wane ne ke biyan sadaki a al'adance?
explanation: Ango ne ke da alhakin biyan sadakin amaryarsa.
subtopic: Al'adun Neman Aure da Bikin Aure

question: Wane abu ne ke nuna kammala bikin aure a gidan ango?
explanation: Kai amarya dakin mijinta shi ne babban mataki na karshe a bikin aure.
subtopic: Al'adun Neman Aure da Bikin Aure

question: Mene ne ake nufi da 'Raba Gari' lokacin hidimar aure?
explanation: Raba katin gayyata ga 'yanuwa da abokan arziki na daga cikin shirye-shiryen biki.
subtopic: Al'adun Neman Aure da Bikin Aure

question: A wajen daura aure, wa ke zama wakilin amarya?
explanation: Waliyi (kamar uba ko dan uwa) shi ne ke wakiltar amarya wajen daura aure.
subtopic: Al'adun Neman Aure da Bikin Aure

question: Wace rawa kawayen amarya ke takawa lokacin shigowa?
explanation: Kawayen amarya na yi wa amarya rakiya da waka da rawa yayin shigowa.
subtopic: Al'adun Neman Aure da Bikin Aure

question: Mene ne sunan bikin da ake yi don murnar cikar kwana bakwai da aure?
explanation: Bikin budan kai shi ne shagalin da ake yi bayan amarya ta kammala kwanakin farko a dakin aure.
subtopic: Al'adun Neman Aure da Bikin Aure

question: Menene ma'anar 'Kayan Gado' a fannin al'adun Hausa?

options.B: Tufafin da ake sawa a jana'iza
options.C: Kudin da ake bai wa sabon ango
options.D: Abincin da ake dafa wa baki

explanation: Kayan gado su ne dukiyar da mutum ya bari bayan rasuwarsa domin raba wa magada.

question: Wane ne ake kira 'Magaji' a tsarin raba gado?

options.D: Bawan da ke kula da gida

explanation: Magaji shi ne wanda yake da damar gado daga cikin dukiya ko gadon da marigayi ya bari.

question: A al'ada, wane ne babban magaji idan mahaifi ya rasu?
explanation: Babban da na namiji ko kuma tsarin Musulunci ne ke nuna wanda ke da fifiko a raba gado.

question: Menene 'Wasiyya' a lamarin raba gado?

options.B: Dokar raba dukiya ga wadanda ba magada ba
options.C: Sunan kudin da ake bayarwa a gado

explanation: Wasiyya ita ce umarni ko baiwa da mutum yake yi daga cikin dukiyarsa kafin rasuwarsa ga wanda ba magaji ba.

question: A tsarin gado, wane ne 'Uwa' ke gado a matsayinta?

options.D: Tana karbar rabon yara mata kawai

explanation: Uwa tana da matsayi da kaso na musamman (kamar rubu'i ko sudusi) a tsarin gado bisa ga shari'a.

question: Wane kalmar Hausa ce ke nufin raba dukiya tsakanin magada?
explanation: Raba gado shi ne sunan da aka fi sani da shi wajen rarraba dukiyar marigayi.

question: Idan mutum ya rasu ba tare da ya bar 'ya'ya ba, wa ke gado?
explanation: Idan babu 'ya'ya, 'yan uwa kamar su uba, uwa, da ‘yan uwan marigayi kan gaje shi.

question: Menene ma'anar kalmar 'Magada'?
explanation: Magada su ne wadancan mutane da shari'a ko al'ada ta amince su karbi gadon marigayi.

question: Wace dukiya ce ba a raba ta cikin kayan gado?

options.A: Dukiyar da aka ba da sadaka kafin mutuwa

explanation: Dukiyar da aka riga aka fitar ko aka bayar da ita kyauta ko sadaka kafin mutuwa bata cikin kayan gado.

question: A Hausance, wane ne 'Majiɓinci' a harkokin gado?

options.C: Dan kasuwar da ya sayi gidan

explanation: Majiɓinci ko waliyi shi ne wanda ke kula da tafiyar da al'amari ciki har da raba gado.

question: Menene sunan bikin da ake yi idan mutum ya rasu?
explanation: Jana'iza shi ne biki ko kuma al'adar da ake gudanarwa idan mutum ya rasu domin binne shi.

question: Wane abu ne ake yi wa mamaci kafin a binne shi?
explanation: Ana wanke gawar musulmi kafin a nannade ta da likkafani a kuma binne ta.

question: Menene ma'anar kalmar 'likkafani' a al'adun mutuwa?

options.B: Farar tsumma ko kyalle na gawa

explanation: Likkafani shi ne farar tsummar da ake nannade gawar mamaci da ita kafin a binne.

question: Wane zance ne ya dace da zaman makoki?
explanation: Ta'aziyya ita ce ziyarar da ake kai wa iyalan mamaci domin jaje da kuma rarrashi.

question: Wane ne ke jagorantar sallar Jana'iza sau da yawa?
explanation: Limami ko malamin unguwa ne ke jagorantar sallar jana'iza bisa ga addinin Musulunci.

question: A al'adance, wane ne ke da alhakin binne gawa a makabarta?
explanation: A al'adance da shari'a, maza ne ke zuwa makabarta domin yin hakar kabari da binne mamaci.

question: Menene ake kira wurin da ake binne gawa?
explanation: Makabarta ita ce filin da aka keɓe na musamman don binne mamata.

question: Wane suna ne ake bai wa matar da mijinta ya rasu?
explanation: Bazawara ita ce matar da mijinta ya rasu ko kuma suka rabu ta hanyar mutuwa.

question: Wane lokaci ne ake yin addu'ar arba'in ga mamaci?
explanation: Wasu al'adu na yin addu'a ta musamman bayan kwanaki arba'in da rasuwar mutum.

question: Menene ake nufi da 'gidan gaskiya' a harshen Hausa?
explanation: 'Gidan gaskiya' zance ne da ake amfani da shi wajen nufin lahira ko makabarta inda kowa zai je.
